                    'baseline access and usage conditions a data provider '
                    'sets for a digital object, without naming who they '
                    'apply to (that is an ODRL Agreement). Built on the '
                    'generic odrlPolicy block, which carries the ODRL '
                    "structure; this block adds only CDIF's own rules. "
